methodology.complete_rule: All mathematical conclusions of a numbered result are covered by compiled explicit overlay representations or verified exact historical specialization. A building block or weaker quantitative rate gets no full credit. Equivalent epsilon/power forms of o(1) and finite positive F_Y-atom conditioning are accepted with their representations stated.
methodology.workload_rule: Exactly the same 19 blocks and 105 weighted units as batches 9 and 10; acquired proof and integration effort across the entire article and companion, not Lean declaration counts, line counts, hours or probability of correctness. Generic work is not credited twice in later chapters without a verified new endpoint.
methodology.literature_boundary: Source-faithful explicit literature premises may support complete relative formalization. The three premises retained from batch10 are ordinary PNT, scalar Stein solution/factors, and process AGG. Batch16 adds the positive-rate multivariate Stein solution with two published quadratic-form Hessian bounds (Röllin/Barbour); entrywise factors, filling, dependency comparison and arithmetic conclusions are derived internally. None of these four premises is internally proved or a new Lean axiom; no CLT or desired Poisson–Gaussian conclusion is assumed.
methodology.unverified_reuse: Names found without a checked sufficient signature receive only component/presumed credit, not complete status.
methodology.validation_scope: Independent source/signature reviews, coordinated global build and exhaustive source/kernel audit; exact publication and remote check outcomes recorded separately.
